purpose_zh: 把一次通勤扩展为可复核的活动链：到达主要活动、应对延误、完成返程，并把延期、不可达和返程未闭合分开。
purpose_en: Extend one commute into a replayable activity chain: reach the primary activity, adapt to delay, close the return leg, and keep deferral, inaccessibility and return failure separate.

method.adaptation_rule: When a declared travel condition exceeds a group schedule budget, a bounded activity deferral may keep the activity chain open; no unbounded rescheduling is allowed.
method.capacity_rule: Mode load above one adds a transparent queue-delay proxy and can trigger return failure; it never creates extra observed capacity.
method.ground_fallback_rule: A missed or over-budget leg may attempt one declared ground fallback if the source mode is not protected from recourse, the target remains within its load screen and a bounded fallback draw accepts it. Walking/accessible source demand is never silently rerouted.
method.air_rule: Air candidate stays blocked and cannot repair a ground activity-chain failure until airspace, airworthiness, operator, insurance, weather, noise, emergency and public-review gates pass.
method.coefficient_boundary: All budgets, delay allowances and adaptation shares are design targets; no local coefficient or external effect size is imported.

hard_gates.stress_gate_policy: A stress-gate failure is a visible stop-and-calibrate signal, not a reason to hide the scenario or to claim local resilience; only the nominal screen is a package-selection gate.

interpretation: This screen makes the cost of a broken daily chain visible beside mode, capacity and accessibility screens. It is not a resident outcome, employee behaviour estimate, service guarantee, local diary sample or professional accessibility audit. Replace design targets with dated grouped OD, activity diaries, timetable/capacity, accessibility and disruption evidence before a local decision.
